messages:
priya_m: Quick sync — planning to flip quantization feature flags for fp16 + int8 profile to a 20% canary tonight 23:00 UTC. Want to confirm scope, guardrails, and owners before the flip.

sam_w: +1. Need perf smoke and quality checks first. Who is owning rollback and alerts?

alex_g: I can own rollback & dashboards. We'll monitor p50 latency, 99th, error_rate, and a small eval set (rouge/bert-sim). Alert if token/sec drops >15% or eval metric delta >2%.

jen_k: @alex_g can you add alert thresholds in the console? I'll open the PR for the flag toggle.

priya_m: Canary audience: 20% random users but exclude enterprise and LRO/batch endpoints. Also exclude orgs with compliance tag. PR should target branch feature/quant-toggle-2026. No int4 in this canary.

qa_lead_ana: I'll run the smoke regression and the quality evals on staging with the int8 profile. Can someone paste the exact flag config we plan to flip?

alex_g: Config (for docs/runbook):
```json
{
  "flags": {
    "enable_fp16": true,
    "enable_int8_profile_v2": true,
    "enable_int4": false
  },
  "canary": {
    "percentage": 20,
    "audience": "random_non_enterprise",
    "exclude_tags": ["enterprise","lro"]
  },
  "rollback_on": {
    "p50_latency_increase_pct": 15,
    "error_rate_increase_pct": 3,
    "eval_metric_drop_pct": 2
  }
}
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z. Canary window: 2h. If green -> scale to 50% for 1h, then 100% if still stable. Will post deploy details in #eng-releases.

sam_w: Please add a synthetic load check at start and at +30m to catch perf regressions early. Also include a cold KV cache pass.

jen_k: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/1234 — toggles + canary config. Needs review @sam_w @alex_g.

alex_g: Reviewing now. Will add the dashboard panels for p50/p99, error_rate, and eval-runner metrics. Also will add a simple runbook snippet with rollback command.

priya_m: Perfect. If no objections, proceed tonight. I'll be on pager and reachable on my cell. :eyes:

ops-bot: Reminder: update runbook 'quant-canary' with explicit rollback steps and contact list.

qa_lead_ana: Running smoke tests now on staging (int8_profile_v2). Posting results in 30m.

sam_w: Thanks — will keep an eye on the PR and tests. :thumbsup:

jen_k: Thanks team, ping me if you need me to flip the flag during the window.

qa_lead_ana: 30m update: regression suite passed on staging (n=200 prompt samples), small drop in token/sec (~6%) but eval metrics within threshold. Posting full logs in docs link shortly.

priya_m: Awesome, thanks Ana. See you all tonight.
